title: Latency Tracerboard: p95/p99 telemetry per path, model, zone
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an end-to-end telemetry and dashboarding flow (the ‘Tracerboard’) that exposes p95 and p99 latency breakdowns across path (API route), model variant, and infra zone. This ticket covers: instrumentation changes, a lightweight aggregation pipeline, dashboard surface, regression detection rules wired to our load harness, and rollout. The goal is actionable SLO-level visibility for engineering and SRE teams so regressions triggered by model upgrades or traffic pattern shifts are detected within our standard cadence (5 minute windows).
acceptance_criteria: Per-path, per-model, per-zone p95 and p99 time-series stored at 1m resolution for 14 days
Dashboards: overview heatmap and drill-down panels (path -> model -> zone) available in Console
Regression detection: automated daily and live regression alerts integrating with regression-harness
Load harness integration: tokens/sec and percentile emitters instrumented to feed the pipeline
Low overhead: end-to-end telemetry adds <5% CPU/latency overhead on critical hot path
Runbook: documented playbook and rollback steps in Confluence linked from the dashboard
